Show Update

Tip Tap Tip Song Contest

item.title: TTT 32: Kick To The Balls
item.description:
Eric & Rachelle discuss Arts fundings and how it pertains to the upcoming Canadian election. However, just when you think it’s going to get intellectual, we drop some ball-kicking to bring it back to the level we normally deal with.  That was a close one. Episode Links:

  • Bas Rutten. Boom!!!
